mechanism.claim: A completed Saturday-Sunday BTC displacement formed under lower weekend participation can be superseded when Monday's first eight hours move in the opposite direction with higher quote-volume per hour. Follow the Monday liquidity-reentry direction through the remaining UTC day.
mechanism.side: strict sign of Monday 00:00-08:00 completed return
mechanism.why_distinct: WMLHR trades a weekly liquidity-regime handoff between a 48-hour weekend and Monday opening block. It is not weekend high-vol overreaction fading, multi-day trend concordance, cross-asset cash-open transfer, run persistence, funding, or a thresholded volatility signal.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: liquidity re-entry against a weekend displacement is later audited on causal RV20 q90, never gated by it
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one sixteen-hour Monday position each week

features.liquidity_reentry: Monday quote per hour > weekend quote per hour
features.source_valid: exact unique minute grids, coherent finite positive OHLC, finite nonnegative quote volume, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: Monday 08:00 UTC after both windows complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.no_liquidity_reentry: Monday direction on every opposite-sign handoff
definitions.weekend_continuation: weekend return side on primary clock
definitions.monday_fade: negative Monday return side on primary clock

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no weekday, window, volume comparison, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
